items.title: Clarence Ford Interview, 1975-12-10
items.q: I'm going to be a wheel someday, I made that with Bobby Over the River.

ctx.x: Did you find Fats had a lot of creativity or would he rely on Dave a lot?

Well I think it would be what, half and half. I couldn't say one was any better than another. I think they were good for each other. Because he would have stuff and Dave would have stuff. See, like for instance, I made Blue Monday with Smiley Lewis first. And then later on they gave it to Fats and put a baritone solo in it. And Fats hit what's bigger than Smiley Lewis. See so it was Smiley and Dave's tune first. Then Fats got it later on. Well everybody associates it with Fats. It's like I'm going to be a wheel…
I remember that but I can't remember.
